result:
I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and Bluesky fail and LinkedIn passes.

- **X — FAIL:** the copy is one paragraph, and X needs at least two.
- **Bluesky — FAIL:** same problem. It is one paragraph, and Bluesky needs two.
- **LinkedIn — PASS:** it has multiple short paragraphs and no hard-rule breaks.

For the two fails, the suggested copy only adds a paragraph break before "Open source today." The counts are 238 characters for X (limit 255) and 219 for Bluesky (limit 300).

I did not run the sub-agent critique or suggestions passes from SKILL.md, and I did not read the blog post. I checked the copy myself against the hard-fail rules in the critique rubric, and the suggested copy keeps the original wording apart from the paragraph break. The two advisory notes on LinkedIn come from my own read of the copy. They say the bullet list gives away too much of the design, and the closing pointer is generic.

The file has the required marker line, the orienting note under the title, the collapsed suggested-copy and advisory sections, and the footer line. It also ends with the two comment prompts SKILL.md's CI section asks for. I did not post a PR comment.
